name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Central Procedural Graph with prioritized Town Shop Arbitrage, proportional workforce-to-land scaling, strict agronomic phase-gates, cluster harvesting, and protected shed liquidation floors.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges and immediately fulfills mature high-margin crops (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins, Strawberries) to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing uncommitted low-margin inventory under strict price floors while protecting animal feed and shop contracts.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash beyond wage reserves into proportional workforce acceleration, contiguous land expansion up to 18 plots, commercial high-yield seeds, and fertilizer.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict operational sequencing: cluster harvesting ready crops, worker drop-offs, watering, livestock feeding, planting, and ground maintenance.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3 if n_animals > 0 else 0); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (net_available_cash >= 180.0 or shop_deliverable_inventory > 0) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate up to 3 market slots to deliver matching mature shed inventory directly to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium; procure shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) when surplus cash covers seed costs and wage buffers.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not commit seed capital if net cash falls below 1.25x midnight payroll reserve; do not purchase shop seeds if shed capacity exceeds 88%; never hold shop produce past contract expiration windows.

attributes.guidance: Evict pending non-urgent buy orders to free order slots; execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings with price >= 0.70 * base_price; only relax floor to 0.45 * base_price or sell shop-eligible crops (Pumpkins, Tomatoes, Carrots) if shed_used >= 92 to prevent discard drops.
attributes.pitfalls: Never fire-sell at sub-0.50 base price during transient shed spikes; never liquidate Wheat below livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3 if n_animals > 0 else 0); strictly forbid open-market sales of shop-eligible crops (Pumpkins, Tomatoes, Carrots) unless shed capacity exceeds 92% emergency saturation.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (> 0.75 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; strictly forbid open-market sales of shop-eligible crops (Pumpkins, Tomatoes, Carrots) unless shed capacity exceeds 92% emergency saturation.

attributes.guidance: Reinvest surplus cash: scale workforce proportionally to land (~1 hand per 1.6 plots) up to 10 hands; expand contiguous land up to a strict 18-plot ceiling when uncultivated_plots <= 1; procure fertilizer and high-yield seeds. Prioritize Strawberry seeds for continuous open-market cash flow. Enforce strict phase-gates: halt Pumpkins Day 24, Tomatoes Day 26, Carrots Day 28, all seeds Day 29.5.
attributes.pitfalls: Never exceed 18 total plots; do not rush 10 hands without sufficient acreage; never purchase seeds past their phase-gate cutoffs; do not allocate capital if net cash drops below 1.30x midnight wage buffer.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch active hands strictly by operational priority: 1) Cluster harvest adjacent mature crops until carrying capacity is reached; 2) Drop off carried items at shed; 3) Water dry crops; 4) Feed hungry livestock; 5) Plant commercial seeds; 6) Weed clearing and ground tilling. Ensure all carried inventory is deposited at shed by step 716 for terminal liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Never prioritize weeding over harvesting or watering; do not leave mature crops unharvested across multi-step windows; ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain; do not drop off single items if adjacent mature crops can be cluster-harvested.
